subject: Renewal: Vendor onboarding refresh + PO path for Acme Cloud
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Daniel Nguyen <daniel.nguyen@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T15:07:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff & procurement portal steps

Hannah —

Thanks for the renewal heads-up. Acme’s legal and procurement teams want to refresh our onboarding artifacts and lock in the PO path early this quarter. Two immediate asks from procurement: a) a clean PO template that matches our billing code, and b) confirmation of any term changes (we flagged the auto-renew and storage retention notes).

I attached the current SOW and our internal procurement checklist — I can route formally once we have a redline. Can you confirm who on your side will lead the procurement portal upload (we need to map the approvers)?

Ideal timeline: portal upload by Tue 6/18, legal review complete by 6/22, PO issued by 6/30. Is that feasible?

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp

Attachments: Acme_SOW_current.pdf (pdf), Acme_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-11T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff & procurement portal steps

Elena —

Appreciate the clear timeline. I’ll own the portal upload and orchestration. Quick notes:
- PO template: I’m attaching our standard PO template pre-filled with Acme billing code; if legal needs the version in your portal format we can convert it.
- Term changes: we propose keeping current term length but agree to clarify the auto-renew language (we can make it opt-in/explicit). Storage retention language will remain unchanged unless you have new regulatory requirements.

Next steps I’ll take immediately:
1) Share Redline_Renewal_v1 (Marcus will draft a slim redline focused on auto-renew + SOW clause).
2) Upload documents to your portal and add Laura as the technical contact for evidence items.
3) Set a 30-minute alignment call with your legal & procurement on 6/13 at 10:00 AM PT — does that work for you and Daniel?

If the dates above hold we should be able to meet your 6/30 PO target.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive — Renewals
Redwood Inference
Phone: 415-555-0127

Attachments: PO_Template_Acme.pdf (pdf)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-corp.com>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-12T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal kickoff & procurement portal steps

Elena/Hannah —

Attached is Redline_Renewal_v1.docx. I kept the edits minimal: clarified auto-renew opt-in language, tightened the SLA response windows for dedicated capacity, and added a short clause about data separation for onboarding evidence. Please review the comments on pages 2 and 4 — those are the items I expect procurement + legal to flag.

I also included a short SOW_amendment_2028.pdf that enumerates the capacity uplift (we’ve proposed +20% baseline capacity starting 2028-07-01). If Acme prefers a tiered commit we can convert this to an appendix.

Marcus Lin
Dir, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redline_Renewal_v1.docx (docx), SOW_amendment_2028.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: Daniel Nguyen <daniel.nguyen@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2028-06-13T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal kickoff & procurement portal steps

Hannah/Marcus —

Thanks — the redline looks reasonable. A few comments from Acme legal: please remove the sentence in the SOW that references a specific maintenance window (we need flexibility), and can you confirm whether the +20% capacity is billed pro-rata for the first month? Procurement also asked for the PO to include a single-line item for the annual commitment and a separate line for overage charges.

We have a portal slot open on 6/18 for uploads; I’ll grant Hannah and Laura the uploader role if you confirm the files. Also, attaching our standard PO form — please populate and upload.

Can we do the 6/13 10:00 AM PT call as planned? I have Daniel attending and legal (Sarah Park).

Regards,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp

Attachments: Acme_PO_Form.pdf (pdf)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-corp.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-16T11:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff & procurement portal steps

Elena —

Quick update after today’s call with Daniel and Sarah:
- We will remove the fixed maintenance window language and replace with a best-effort notice clause (Marcus to edit SOW page 3).
- Capacity billing: billing will be pro-rata for the first month for the +20% uplift; I’ve asked finance to include both the annual commitment line and a clearly labeled overage line in the PO.
- I uploaded the following to your portal (slot 6/18 confirmed): Redline_Renewal_v1.docx, SOW_amendment_2028.pdf, PO_Template_Acme.pdf (pre-filled).

Marissa (legal ops) — looped you for a quick redline check. Please confirm if you want us to accept their minor edit to clause 7 or propose alternate language.

Elena, next milestone: procurement issues PO to us by 6/30. I’ll follow up with a short confirmation email once I see the issued PO.

Thanks all — close to green.

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive — Renewals
Redwood Inference

Bcc: internal finance mailbox (fwd on approval)
